column1: # Section dispositions: authored input to the P1 census generator.
# The section id is the id of an <h2>, <h3> or <h4> of the pinned index.bs.
# The kind is one of idl, op, requirement, rule, slot, or * for every kind.
# The disposition is one of the SPEC-MANIFEST.md vocabulary: owned,
# requirement, foreignBoundary, hostOnly, refused, evidenceOnly, targetOnly.
# A row's disposition is resolved by walking its heading ancestry from the
# innermost <h4> outward to the <h2>, preferring a kind-specific line to the
# section's wildcard line at each level. A per-row override in overrides.tsv
# beats every line here. A row that no line reaches fails generation, and a
# line that no row uses also fails generation.
# Seeded from the section table of SPEC-MANIFEST.md. census/README.md records
# where each line departs from a literal reading of that table and why.
# SPEC-MANIFEST.md: rs-class is owned, its IDL members hostOnly at the boundary.
# The underlying source API is the UnderlyingSource dictionary and its
# callbacks, which SPEC-MANIFEST.md names foreignBoundary by dictionary.
# Transfer via postMessage() is the transferable-streams protocol, which
# The piping requirements are stated inside the ReadableStreamPipeTo block,
# which lives under rs-abstract-ops. SPEC-MANIFEST.md dispositions them
# requirement, realized by that reference algorithm.
